subsystems.name: Legal language model
subsystems.role: Understands and generates contract language, clauses, and legal reasoning.

subsystems.name: Negotiation engine
subsystems.role: Conducts multi-round negotiations, proposes terms, and evaluates offers.

subsystems.name: Smart contract compiler
subsystems.role: Translates agreed natural-language terms into executable code.

subsystems.name: Blockchain execution layer
subsystems.role: Deploys and runs smart contracts on a distributed ledger.

subsystems.name: Compliance and risk module
subsystems.role: Ensures contracts meet regulatory and legal constraints.

subsystems.name: Human oversight interface
subsystems.role: Allows lawyers to review, approve, and intervene in agent actions.

buildSteps.title: Assemble legal corpus
buildSteps.detail: Collect and anonymise contracts, statutes, case law, and regulations across jurisdictions to train the system.

buildSteps.title: Fine-tune and align models
buildSteps.detail: Train a large language model on legal text and align it with negotiation objectives using human feedback.

buildSteps.title: Build negotiation protocols
buildSteps.detail: Define agent strategies, utility functions, and a communication language for multi-round bargaining.

buildSteps.title: Develop smart contract generation
buildSteps.detail: Create a compiler that maps clauses to code and includes formal verification to catch errors.

buildSteps.title: Integrate with blockchain testnets
buildSteps.detail: Deploy generated contracts on test networks, simulate execution, and test oracle interactions.

buildSteps.title: Implement compliance checks
buildSteps.detail: Encode regulatory rules into a rule engine and validate against real and synthetic scenarios.

buildSteps.title: Create human-in-the-loop interface
buildSteps.detail: Build review, override, and logging tools so legal professionals can supervise the agents.

buildSteps.title: Pilot in sandbox
buildSteps.detail: Run closed trials with legal experts on standardised contracts to measure accuracy, safety, and speed.

prerequisites.why: Needed to parse and generate complex legal language.
Provide the execution environment for on-chain contracts (e.g., Ethereum, Solana).
Essential to prove that generated code matches the agreed intent and is secure.
Enable reliable mapping of legal concepts to code and compliance rules.

prerequisites.tech: Regulatory frameworks for AI in law
prerequisites.why: Liability, authorisation, and accountability for autonomous legal agents remain undefined.
Required to evaluate and compare negotiation performance objectively.

pathway.milestone: AI-assisted drafting and review of contracts
pathway.unlocks: Faster preparation and fewer clerical errors in legal documents.

pathway.milestone: AI negotiation support for simple, standardised agreements
pathway.unlocks: Reduced time and cost in routine contract negotiations.

pathway.milestone: Autonomous generation and deployment of simple smart contracts from natural language
pathway.unlocks: Automated execution of routine agreements without manual coding.

pathway.milestone: End-to-end autonomous negotiation and execution for bounded legal domains
pathway.unlocks: Frictionless, low-cost transactions, but only with new regulatory safeguards.
